name: Hanna Aretha
bio: Hanna Aretha is an Indonesian actress. Her debut feature film role is in Kamila Andini's Four Seasons in Java (2026).

credits.title: Four Seasons in Java
credits.overview: Pertiwi returns to her hometown after spending two decades in prison to rebuild her life. There, she finds power in things that have been abandoned: discarded electronic devices that mysteriously light up and a community of outcasts living on the fringes of society.
